title: Add Map Marker Card
content: Create location card. Container: bg-white rounded-xl shadow overflow-hidden. Map: aspect-video, embedded Google/Mapbox map or static image. Content: p-6. Location name: text-xl font-bold. Address: text-gray-600, formatted with line breaks. Contact: phone and email links. Hours: today hours with "See all hours" expandable. Directions button: flex items-center gap-2, opens in maps app.

variants.simple: Create location card with map, address, and directions.
variants.detailed: Create location card. Container: bg-white rounded-xl shadow overflow-hidden. Map: aspect-video, embedded Google/Mapbox map or static image. Content: p-6. Location name: text-xl font-bold. Address: text-gray-600, formatted with line breaks. Contact: phone and email links. Hours: today hours with "See all hours" expandable. Directions button: flex items-center gap-2, opens in maps app.
variants.advanced: Create full location component. Map options: interactive map (Mapbox, Google Maps, Leaflet), static map image for performance, lazy load map on visibility. Map features: zoom controls, marker with custom icon, popup on marker click, satellite toggle. Multiple locations: list selector that updates map, or map with multiple pins. Marker clustering: for many locations. Geolocation: "Find nearest location" using browser geolocation. Location card: name, address (formatted), phone (click to call), email (click to email), website link. Business hours: today hours prominent, expandable full schedule, indicate currently open/closed, special holiday hours. Features/amenities: icons for parking, wheelchair access, WiFi, etc. Photos: small gallery of location photos. Directions: "Get Directions" opens native maps with location, distance from user if available. Share: copy address, share link. Reviews: rating and review count, link to reviews. Contact form: embedded form specific to location. Nearby: show nearby locations. Store locator pattern: search input, results list, map. Accessibility: map not essential (provide text alternative), all info available without map.
